text:
maya: Heads-up — Peregrine Labs asked to move 5 preview seats from the data team to a new ML infra pod. They said it's urgent; trying to avoid churn at renewal.
eli: Do we know current seat usage? I can pull the numbers now.
sam: i see 12 active seats of 25 provisioned last check, but several invited users haven't logged in. i can run a usage check and list who hasn't accepted.
maya: thanks. primary asks: 1) reassign 5 seats 2) run a 30m enablement for the new pod 3) short adoption survey to power users.
devon: renewal risk note — low adoption signal. recommend targeted enablement + quick wins doc. we should prep a one-pager on performance/cost best practices.
clara: i'll create a 3-question pulse survey and send it to power users. draft Qs: 1) how often do you use API? 2) biggest blocker? 3) would you recommend Redwood to a colleague? link will be posted here when ready.
maya: onboarding details — new team needs SSO invites and access to private model variants. @onboard-bot can you run the invite + role assign?
onboard-bot: /invite --account peregrine --emails "team2@peregrine.com,alex.k@peregrine.com" --role contributor --notify true
eli: grabbing usage snapshot now — quick console paste: UsageAPI GET /accounts/peregrine/usage -> active_seats:12, invited_pending:4, seat_quota:25, last_activity_days_avg:18
sam: ok i'll reassign 5 seats from group "data-analytics" -> "ml-infra" and update the audit log. doing it during low-traffic window (1am PT) unless anyone objects.
devon: please also add a canary rollout plan for any model pins we change — avoid unexpected perf regressions. i'll draft the rollback steps.
clara: survey draft ready: https://redwood.co/surveys/peregrine-preview-draft — short link, TTL 7 days. i'll queue it to go after enablement session.
maya: enablement agenda (30m): 1) quick platform intro + best practices (7m) 2) access & SSO walkthrough (5m) 3) model selection & pinning guidance (8m) 4) caching/batching tips (5m) 5) Q&A (5m). can we get a product engineer for the model section?
sam: i can host Fri 10:00am PT. calendar invite sent to contacts on file. :calendar:
devon: product eng heads-up — we need a short deck and 3 example prompts for low-latency generation use cases. if product can't double for the session, i'll cover the slides and ping for follow-up.
maya: i'll draft the renewal outreach note to the AE and exec sponsor after the enablement. target: highlight adoption plan, seat reassign, and ops ticket numbers.
eli: done — exported the list of invited-but-inactive users and DM'd it to maya & sam.
clara: survey queued to send 2 hours after session ends. i'll capture responses in the CS dashboard and tag anything with NPS <= 6 as high-touch follow-up.
sam: seat reassign complete. audit log entry: AR-1798. notified primary admin at peregrine.
onboard-bot: ticket created: CS-4521 (seat reassign + SSO invite verification).
maya: great work team. next steps: 1) run enablement Fri 10am 2) survey 2h after 3) capture results & prepare renewal play. i'll post a recap after the session. :thumbsup:
devon: noted — i'll attach the rollback checklist to the ticket and prepare the best-practices one-pager.
